dedupe_keys.name: xiaomi mi 8 gnss measurements under canopy with and without a ground plane

description: This dataset records forty days of repeated ten-minute GNSS observations using a Xiaomi Mi 8 smartphone near Technical University in Zvolen, Slovakia. Each day covers open, partial-canopy and full-canopy points; the first twenty days omit a ground plane and the next twenty include it. Mendeley version 3 provides rover and reference-station RINEX data, ephemerides, reference coordinates and original GNSSlogger text, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is static point tests, not vehicle trajectories, and exact calendar dates require the file-level directory information. The repository warns that GNSSlogger acquisition intervals can exceed their corresponding RINEX intervals. These differences and the single phone design are limitations for transfer. Modellers could check obstruction and receiver-error assumptions in positioning-dependent infrastructure simulations. model-pyrtklib and data-google-smartphone-decimeter-gnss-datasets offer related processing and comparison resources. No observations were downloaded or postprocessed.
